tagline: Pattaya's captive day-trip island — high-frequency short hop.
summary: Koh Larn sits about five nautical miles east of Pattaya's Bali Hai Pier and absorbs a constant stream of day-trippers from the Eastern Seaboard — roughly five to six thousand on a typical weekend and as many as twenty thousand on peak holidays. Na Ban Pier is the main landing, with speedboats and ferries running throughout the day on the short, sheltered crossing. The pier crush, the noisy speedboat scrum and the queues at peak are the recurring pain. That makes Koh Larn the cleanest proof corridor in the Gulf cluster: a short, high-frequency, captive hop where a premium in-app foiling tier — paired with the Bangkok and Pattaya gateway demand — can prove the model before the longer Gulf legs.

use_cases.title: Pattaya (Bali Hai) ↔ Koh Larn premium island transfer
use_cases.body: A fast, smooth foiling hop across the short crossing to Na Ban Pier that lifts day-trippers clear of the crowded, noisy speedboat scrum. On peak holidays — when the pier groans under twenty thousand visitors — it is the calm, pre-booked premium lane.

use_cases.title: Bangkok day-trip bundles
use_cases.body: Pair the foiling hop with a land leg from Bangkok or Pattaya into a single, pre-booked day-trip product. It turns a fragmented chain of car, queue and speedboat into one seamless premium escape.

journeys.today: Shared diesel speedboat or slow public ferry, ~30-40 min, with pier queues and crowding at peak.
journeys.with_navier: A fast, smooth foiling hop — quiet, dry and clear of the pier crush, on a premium pre-booked lane.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Koh Larn is a single short, sheltered ~5 nm open-water hop — deep inside the 70 nm all-electric envelope and ideal for high-frequency daily rotations, with Pattaya's Ocean Marina nearby as a ready shore-charging and berthing base.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta LR is not needed for the Koh Larn hop itself, but its ~2,000 nm hybrid range, with no charging-infrastructure dependency, lets the same Pattaya base reach longer Eastern Seaboard and cross-Gulf corridors that all-electric range would not cover.

competitive_landscape: Conventional speedboats only; no premium electric scheduled tier.
